system.description:
Imprisoned before memory, worshipped by those who want everything to end. He does not speak to his Warlocks — he leaks into them.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Once per day, touch a creature or object and unravel it — deals 1d10 necrotic damage per 4 Warlock levels (minimum 1d10), Fortitude halves, and reduces the target's AC by 1 until the target's next long rest.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, touch a nonmagical object no larger than a door — it begins to slowly deteriorate, crumbling to dust over the next hour. Creatures cannot detect this until the deterioration is visible.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, open a rift to the Far Realm in a 20ft radius centred on a point within 60ft.
  • All creatures inside make a Will save against your Class Save DC or are stunned for 1 round and take 4d8 psychic damage.
  • The rift lingers 1 round — creatures that end their turn inside repeat the save.
